confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate for July 2026, which is peak season on the Algarve, so accommodation anchors reflect summer rates rather than off-season prices. Restaurant prices are the most reliable; drinks and hotel rates are less certain. No live listings or menus were checked. FX: two search summaries of rba.gov.au both reported the 15 Oct 2026 USD rate of 0.6955, but they disagreed on whether a 16 Oct 2026 figure (0.6947) was published, so the 15 Oct observation is used. The rate was taken from search-result summaries and was not verified by opening the RBA table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on other Algarve coastal resort towns in Portugal (such as Lagos and Portimão) and Portuguese tourist-town pricing generally. Drink anchors use the local beer-to-cocktail and beer-to-wine price relationship where direct knowledge is weaker.
